summary: Off-registry tarball dependency from mutable GitHub raw URL
details: package.json declares its only dependency `node-acct-utils` as a direct tarball URL (https://github.com/GamerD11/ping_test/raw/refs/heads/main/node-acct-utils-1.0.0.tgz) on a personal GitHub account's mutable `main` branch, with no registry version, no commit SHA, and no integrity hash. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes are currently at that URL and runs any lifecycle scripts inside the fetched tarball. The shipped index.js is an inert stub, so the manifest line is the entire delivery surface. The dependency key is unrelated to any legitimate well-known package and the host is unrelated to any declared publisher or repository, consistent with a lure that forces resolution of attacker-controlled code at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
